name: White Queen
source:
Based off of the White Queen from Carroll's [i]Through the Looking-Glass[/i]. She is a self proclaimed precog who directs Alice to find the Red Queen. Perhaps she is the one who loves 'Alice' the most in this world...

The White Queen's goal is simply to help Alice, but what secrets does she hide behind her calm eyes?

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/who-is-the-red-queen/]official website[/url]]
